mission: PR #343 Wave 5-6 — engine capabilities + Studio submission convergence
why_this_file: docs/evidence/p0/evidence.json is generated by scripts/p0_evidence.py, which requires a live PostgreSQL at NEXUS_DATABASE_URL (default 127.0.0.1:5433). That service is not present in this environment, so the P0 bundle was NOT regenerated here — fabricating its command output would violate the bundle's own contract. This addendum records the Wave-6 evidence that WAS measured, bound to the same revision, so the next Postgres-backed run can regenerate evidence.json and keep this one as the studio-lane record.

stdout_tail: checks: version-lockstep, docs-index, law-test-resolution, law-numbering, claim-witnesses, fail-open-defaults, board-truth

claims: POST /api/studio/projects/{project_id}/renders requires the dashboard bearer/session principal, the project-scope policy and an HMAC-signed envelope over the raw body.
The submission is translated by nagar.creative.build_creative_payload (the single trust translation) and enqueued as one durable creative_render row.

The worker executes the pinned committed revision through the canonical CommandBus, verifies the artifact independently, publishes atomically under the attempt fence and registers a content-addressed AssetVersion with a derived receipt reference.
GET /api/studio/projects/{project_id}/jobs/{job_id}/state reports the same durable row.
